name: lattice-dimers
description: Domino and domicule tilings and the dimer entropy of the king's graph: exact counts on rectangles, cylinders and tori, rigorous bounds, papers, OEIS entries and a gallery that draws any tiling.

scripts.benchmark: node harness/benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -m 7 && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-Formula.js && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js -n 10 -m 3 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js -n 3 -o 10 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js
scripts.benchmark:periodic: node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 10 -m 5 && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 10 -o 5 -m 1 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 3 -o 6 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --cylinder -n 10 -m 6 && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --cylinder -n 10 -o 6 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js
scripts.benchmark:diagonal: node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 10 -m 7 && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 10 -o 7 -m 3 --only domiculeDiagonalSolver-Modular.js && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 1 -o 10 --only domiculeDiagonalSolver-Modular.js
scripts.benchmark:all: cargo build --release --locked && pnpm benchmark:periodic && node harness/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 1 -o 5 -m 1 --only periodicTilingSolver-BigInt.js && pnpm benchmark && pnpm benchmark:domicule && pnpm benchmark:diagonal
